info.name: Build With Me / Connexd - Complete API v9.0 (Journey Ordered)
info.description:
Complete Postman collection organized by feature and user journey.

Request numbering is continuous across all folders.

Authentication follows registration, verification, one-time role logins, password recovery, Firebase, current-user, and refresh-session order.

The owner, applicant, and admin login variants run once and save role-specific collection tokens for later modules.

The removed PUT /api/projects/:id/enhanced compatibility route is not included.
